headlines.title_zh: OpenAI 希望公司通过承诺不查看他们的数据来信任其敏感工作
headlines.title_en: OpenAI wants companies to trust it with sensitive work by promising not to look at their data
headlines.author: Jonathan Kemper
headlines.event_summary_zh: OpenAI 正在测试一项名为“私人推理”的新功能，该功能允许公司在其最强大的模型上运行查询，而 OpenAI 无法访问数据。首席执行官 Sam Altman 表示，该公司目前正在向首批企业客户试用之前宣布的产品。更好的隐私使人工智能对
headlines.event_summary_en:
OpenAI is testing a new feature called "Private Inference"that lets companies run queries on its most powerful models without OpenAI being able to access the data. CEO Sam Altman said the company is now piloting the previously announced offering with its first enterprise customers. Better privacy makes AI useful for a much wider range of work, Altman wrote.
